{{Conjecture|legends}}
According to the translation of an ancient text by [[Emiel Skoff]], a native '''group''' at one point inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Forntay]]. The planet's inhabitants supposedly defeated a faction that had subjugated them, but ultimately the former also went extinct.<ref name="GG62">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref>
